statement: Genesis grant over the product https://acme.example/products/shop, held by mailto:holder@acme.example: the founding of its authority log under the authority profile.
why: A test-fixture re-founding, not a transfer: the profile's log for acme opens here. GEN@2 was a stand-in signed by a key discarded with its build, so no act under it can be signed; this founding binds the holder's key, kept with the fixture from here on. It is the last re-founding (authority.md Appendix A, A-5, ruled 2026-11-02). In a real product the founder keeps their key.
